topic: Substances, mixtures, boiling, and solution concentration
key_concepts: Distilled water is a substance and saltwater is a mixture
The boiling temperature of distilled water stays constant while boiling
The boiling temperature of saltwater changes during boiling
Boiling temperature can help distinguish substances from mixtures
Mixtures may be classified as solutions, colloids, or suspensions
Colloids have a dispersed phase and a dispersing medium
Percent by mass concentration equals solute mass divided by solution mass times 100
Percent by volume concentration equals solute volume divided by solution volume times 100
A dilute solution has a small amount of solute
Percent concentration can be used to calculate the amount of solute in a product
Disinfectant and hand sanitizer can be prepared by diluting a bleach solution
